title: c00lkid executor v6.0
script:
-- [[ c00lkid Executor BETA v6.0 ]] --
-- By Clash | Follow @clash_mbg on TikTok

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local IMAGE_ID = "rbxassetid://117513348313707"
local MERAH_BIASA = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30)

for _, name in ipairs({"c00lkidExecutor", "c00lkidWelcome", "c00lkidToggle"}) do
    if CoreGui:FindFirstChild(name) then
        CoreGui[name]:Destroy()
    end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- [[ 1. WELCOME — DARI ATAS KE BAWAH KE TENGAH ]]
-- ============================================================================
local welcomeGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
welcomeGui.Name = "c00lkidWelcome"
welcomeGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
welcomeGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
welcomeGui.Parent = CoreGui

local welcomeFrame = Instance.new("Frame", welcomeGui)
welcomeFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 200)
welcomeFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -400) -- MULAI DARI ATAS LAYAR
welcomeFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
welcomeFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

local wStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", welcomeFrame)
wStroke.Thickness = 2
wStroke.Color = MERAH_BIASA

local welcomeImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel", welcomeFrame)
welcomeImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 150)
welcomeImg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 10)
welcomeImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
welcomeImg.Image = IMAGE_ID
welcomeImg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit

local welcomeText = Instance.new("TextLabel", welcomeFrame)
welcomeText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
welcomeText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -40)
welcomeText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
welcomeText.Text = "c00lkid executor v6.0"
welcomeText.TextColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
welcomeText.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
welcomeText.TextSize = 20
welcomeText.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
welcomeText.TextScaled = true

-- Animasi: TURUN DARI ATAS KE TENGAH
task.spawn(function()
    -- Turun ke tengah
    TweenService:Create(welcomeFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -100) -- TENGAH LAYAR
    }):Play()
    
    -- Diam 2 detik
    task.wait(2)
    
    -- Naik ke atas lagi
    TweenService:Create(welcomeFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -400) -- KE ATAS LAYAR
    }):Play()
    
    task.wait(0.7)
    welcomeGui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- [[ 2. UI UTAMA — c00lkid Executor BETA v6.0 ]]
-- ============================================================================
local uiGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
uiGui.Name = "c00lkidExecutor"
uiGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
uiGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
uiGui.Parent = CoreGui

local main = Instance.new("Frame", uiGui)
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 340)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -170)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true
main.ClipsDescendants = true
main.Visible = false

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", main)
stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Color = MERAH_BIASA

local bgImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel", main)
bgImage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
bgImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bgImage.Image = IMAGE_ID
bgImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
bgImage.ZIndex = 1

local overlay = Instance.new("Frame", main)
overlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
overlay.ZIndex = 2

local header = Instance.new("Frame", main)
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
header.BackgroundColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.ZIndex = 10

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", header)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "c00lkid Executor BETA v6.0"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
title.TextSize = 18
title.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
title.TextScaled = true
title.ZIndex = 11

local content = Instance.new("Frame", main)
content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -45)
content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 45)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.ZIndex = 10

local exampleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", content)
exampleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20)
exampleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 10)
exampleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
exampleLabel.Text = "Example: print('Hello c00lkid!')"
exampleLabel.TextColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
exampleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
exampleLabel.TextSize = 11
exampleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
exampleLabel.ZIndex = 10

local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox", content)
textBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 60)
textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 35)
textBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
textBox.Text = ""
textBox.PlaceholderText = "-- Tulis script di sini --"
textBox.PlaceholderColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
textBox.TextColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
textBox.TextSize = 11
textBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
textBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
textBox.MultiLine = true
textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
textBox.ZIndex = 10

local tbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", textBox)
tbStroke.Thickness = 2
tbStroke.Color = MERAH_BIASA

local execBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", content)
execBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.43, 0, 0, 35)
execBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 105)
execBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
execBtn.Text = "EXECUTE"
execBtn.TextColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
execBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
execBtn.TextSize = 14
execBtn.ZIndex = 10

local ebStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", execBtn)
ebStroke.Thickness = 2
ebStroke.Color = MERAH_BIASA

local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", content)
clearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.43, 0, 0, 35)
clearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0, 105)
clearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
clearBtn.Text = "CLEAR"
clearBtn.TextColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
clearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
clearBtn.TextSize = 14
clearBtn.ZIndex = 10

local cbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", clearBtn)
cbStroke.Thickness = 2
cbStroke.Color = MERAH_BIASA

execBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(execBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 0, 0)}):Play() end)
execBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(execBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)}):Play() end)
clearBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(clearBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 0, 0)}):Play() end)
clearBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(clearBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)}):Play() end)

local propsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", content)
propsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
propsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 150)
propsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
propsBtn.Text = "📦 PROPS GUI v5"
propsBtn.TextColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
propsBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
propsBtn.TextSize = 13
propsBtn.ZIndex = 10

local pbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", propsBtn)
pbStroke.Thickness = 2
pbStroke.Color = MERAH_BIASA

propsBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(propsBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 0, 0)}):Play() end)
propsBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(propsBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)}):Play() end)

local creditLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
creditLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
creditLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -27)
creditLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
creditLabel.Text = "Follow @clash_mbg on TikTok for next update"
creditLabel.TextColor3 = MERAH_BIASA
creditLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
creditLabel.TextSize = 12
creditLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
creditLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
creditLabel.ZIndex = 11

-- ============================================================================
-- [[ 3. FUNGSI EXECUTE + CLEAR + PROPS ]]
-- ============================================================================
execBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local code = textBox.Text
    if code and code ~= "" then
        local func = loadstring(code)
        if func then
            pcall(func)
            execBtn.Text = "✅ EXECUTED"
            task.wait(1)
            execBtn.Text = "EXECUTE"
        else
            execBtn.Text = "❌ ERROR"
            task.wait(1)
            execBtn.Text = "EXECUTE"
        end
    end
end)

clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() textBox.Text = "" end)

propsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/w5FYqDgg/raw"))()
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- [[ 4. TOGGLE BUTTON — KOTAK (BUKAN BULAT), MUTER KANAN KIRI ]]
-- ============================================================================
local toggleGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
toggleGui.Name = "c00lkidToggle"
toggleGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
toggleGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
toggleGui.Parent = CoreGui

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("ImageButton", toggleGui)
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -30)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Image = IMAGE_ID
toggleBtn.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
toggleBtn.Active = true

-- KOTAK (bukan bulat)
Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

local tStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", toggleBtn)
tStroke.Thickness = 2
tStroke.Color = MERAH_BIASA

local rotateDir = 1
task.spawn(function()
    while toggleBtn.Parent do
        toggleBtn.Rotation = toggleBtn.Rotation + (rotateDir * 3)
        if toggleBtn.Rotation >= 15 then rotateDir = -1 end
        if toggleBtn.Rotation <= -15 then rotateDir = 1 end
        task.wait(0.03)
    end
end)

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = not main.Visible
end)

local dragging2, dragStart2, startPos2
toggleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging2 = true
        dragStart2 = input.Position
        startPos2 = toggleBtn.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging2 = false end
        end)
    end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging2 and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart2
        toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(startPos2.X.Scale, startPos2.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos2.Y.Scale, startPos2.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- [[ 5. MUNCULKAN UI SETELAH WELCOME ]]
-- ============================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(3.3) -- Welcome total duration
    main.Visible = true
    toggleBtn.Visible = true
end)

print("🔥 c00lkid Executor BETA v6.0 — LOADED!")
print("📱 Follow @clash_mbg on TikTok for next update")
